verdict.rationale: An API reference exists for Computer endpoints, including the analytics usage endpoint page (GET /v2/analytics/computer/usage). A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is served at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json, which could back an interactive reference. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or lets you run examples in-browser; only static examples such as the claude mcp add command appear. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground, runnable request examples in the reference, Computer task API coverage beyond analytics, and hands-on corroboration.
